cases.name: bc_overlapping_speech_mid_turn
cases.description: C [0,6000] (0.1 min). Backchannel [2000,2500] overlaps counterpart speech: benign 1/1, 10 per minute. Backchannel rate 1/0.1 = 10. Starts 4000 ms from the turn end and in no pause: not well placed, 0/1.

cases.name: bc_partially_overlapping_turn_end
cases.description: Backchannel [5800,6300] overlaps C [0,6000] by 200 ms: benign. Starts 200 ms before the turn end: well placed.

cases.name: bc_inside_scripted_pause_not_overlapping_speech
cases.description: C [0,7000] with scripted pause [3000,4000]: speech 6000. Backchannel [3200,3700] lies entirely in the pause, overlapping no counterpart speech: not benign (0/1). It still counts for backchannel rate (10 per minute) and starts inside a pause: well placed 1/1.

cases.name: bc_inside_unscripted_pause_not_overlapping_speech
cases.description: As above with an unscripted pause [3000,4000]: not benign, well placed, 10 per minute.

cases.name: bc_in_silence_after_turn_does_not_overlap
cases.description: Backchannel [8000,8500] is 2000 ms after C [0,6000] ends: not benign, still 10 per minute, not well placed (0/1).

cases.name: bc_start_300ms_before_turn_end_is_well_placed

cases.name: bc_start_301ms_before_turn_end_is_not_well_placed
cases.description: Backchannel [5699,6199] starts 301 ms before the turn end: not well placed. Benign (overlaps speech).

cases.name: bc_start_300ms_after_turn_end_is_well_placed

cases.name: bc_start_301ms_after_turn_end_is_not_well_placed

cases.name: bc_duration_1000ms_is_substantive

cases.name: bc_three_words_short_turn_is_a_backchannel

cases.name: bc_four_words_short_turn_is_substantive
cases.description: 500 ms with 4 words: substantive. Mid-sentence 1/1, no backchannels.
